study: Vernon-Feagans et al. 2013 (Targeted Reading Intervention webcam coaching; J. Educational Psychology 105(4))
delivery_evidence: Genuine mix of in-person and online: all experimental teachers received an in-person 3-day summer institute (led by the intervention director and trained reading coaches) AND, during the year, biweekly live webcam/video-conferencing literacy coaching plus a website of downloadable materials/manuals -- 'a technology driven professional development program that included ongoing biweekly [webcam] coaching' (Method, p.1179-1181).
test_alignment_evidence: Included reading outcomes are the Woodcock-Johnson III Diagnostic Reading Battery subtests (Word Attack, Letter-Word Identification, Passage Comprehension, Spelling of Sounds), commercial standardized norm-referenced instruments not tailored to TRI (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table 5, p.1183).
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting the Targeted Reading Intervention, a specific named program with its own instructional materials package -- website materials for instruction, downloadable instructions/manuals, downloadable leveled books, and a defined diagnostic protocol (Word Work, Diagnostic Map) that the classroom teacher uses in one-on-one struggling-reader sessions (Method, p.1178-1181).
outcome_timing_evidence: WJ-III DRB outcomes measured in spring (immediate post-test, end of the single treatment year); only one post wave, no delayed follow-up (extraction timepoint 'spring, immediate post'; Table 5, p.1183).
